title: 10/14 RattleSnake 2in1 for Dynavap
description:
RattleSnake Stem For Dynavap
Twist up your Dynavap session with this glass RattleSnake stem which features a small airport, 10mm and 14mm connection. It offers a simple yet smooth experience when paired with a dynavap tip. and your favourite 10mm or 14mm bubbler.
The small aiport on the RattleSnake 2in1 is a good size which alleviates some draw restriction when using with your bubbler and of course can be covered or partially covered while in use.
Dynavap Tip & Cap NOT INCLUDED.
Included
1 x RattleSnake 2in1 (CHOOSE COLOUR)
